thread:
Anna: Heads up — ACME reported a discrepancy: their reserved commit credits didn't apply for 2025-06-01 00:00-01:00 UTC window, they were billed full. Can we triage? cc @mike-billing @sophia-eng
Mike: Can you drop the partner claim_id and any invoice ref?
Anna: claim_id=acme-20250601-001, invoice=inv-ACME-202506. Partner says they saw calls but no credit.
Sophia: I'm pulling ingester logs now. Quick note: we had a short pause in webhook delivery around 00:02 UTC, few retries 503->200. Might be related.
James: Ops saw a transient 503 to our connector at 00:02:30, service recovered by 00:04. No rolling restarts.
Anna: Partner expects credit under the committed usage SLA. Need to determine whether the missing events caused an undercount for that hour.
Mike: We need entitlement activation timeline + raw events for that hour. If entitlement was active, policy is backfill first, then credit if backfill can't reconstruct.
Anna: Sending entitlement history (pasted privately) — shows active_at=2025-05-01, no deactivation.
Sophia: DB confirms ent_active true at 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z.
James: Our hourly rollup looks for at-least-one event per hour; if rollup receives zero events we count zero unless backfilled. The webhook pause may have dropped enough to make that hour look empty.
Anna: OK. @sophia-eng can you run a targeted backfill from kafka/raw events for acme for 00:00-01:00 and see reconstructed usage?
Sophia: Yes. I'll run a targeted backfill query against raw stream and report results. ETA ~30m.
metering-bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=bkfill-1754321987-1 status=queued
James: Filed an incident note linking this thread (inc-2025-06-01-connector-blip).
Sophia: Backfill started. Query: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM raw_usage WHERE partner='acme' AND ts >= '2025-06-01T00:00:00Z' AND ts < '2025-06-01T01:00:00Z' GROUP BY hour; (running)
Anna: Notifying partner that we're investigating, ETA ~45m.
Sophia: Backfill complete. Reconstructed usage = 98% of committed quota for that hour. Shortfall = 2% (~$12.34 per contract rounding).
Mike: If backfill reconstructs >= committed we don't credit. Since it's below, we'll issue a prorated credit per SLA. I'll prepare the ledger entry and credit memo.
James: Ops note: we'll add an alert rule for connector pause > 5m to reduce future impact.
Sophia: Filed GH-4987 to make hourly rollup pull from kafka short-window (<10m gaps) before marking zero.
Anna: Great. Mike — please post the credit and reply to partner with the breakdown + timeline. I'll close the loop.
Mike: Will do. Posting credit now and updating billing: credit_ref=cr-Acme-20250601-001 amount=12.34 USD.
Anna: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) GH-4987 for rollup resilience, (2) inc-2025-06-01 postmortem, (3) confirm alerting. I'll archive notes and update partner message when credit lands. :thumbsup:
